# Core Summary
A 10-second vertical action drama set in a bustling Chinese open-air market, following a multi-shot progression (8 shots) where a skilled female butcher `<ID_A>` defends her stall from a bullying man `<ID_B>`. Shot 1 establishes the busy market and the inciting incident of a kicked bowl. Shot 2 and 3 escalate tension with a cold stare and arrogant dialogue. Shot 4 and 5 deliver the action climax with a swift grab and shoulder throw. Shot 6 and 7 resolve the conflict with physical dominance and a moral statement. Shot 8 concludes with the bully retreating amidst crowd approval.

# Scene
[shot1][00:00-00:02] A busy露天 (open-air) market aisle with concrete flooring. Center frame features a large, worn wooden meat case with various cuts of raw pork arranged neatly. A stainless steel meat basin sits on the ground near the case. Overhead, exposed bulbs cast a warm, slightly yellow glow. Background shows blurred stalls and hanging meats. Audio: Chaotic market ambient noise, heavy chopping sounds, sharp metallic clang of a kicked basin.
[shot2][00:02-00:03] Background consists of soft, out-of-focus market lights (bokeh effect), creating a dark, blurred backdrop that isolates the foreground subject. Lighting is dimmer here, focusing on facial features. Audio: Sudden drop in ambient noise, low-frequency suspenseful BGM begins.
[shot3][00:03-00:04] Market aisle perspective, looking down the row of stalls. Overhead yellow bulbs create high-contrast shadows on the ground. Background figures are blurred bystanders. Lighting is dramatic, emphasizing the subject's silhouette. Audio: Tense BGM continues, mixed with distant crowd murmur.
[shot4][00:04-00:05] Narrow market aisle space allowing lateral movement. The ground is concrete, slightly worn. Background is motion-blurred due to camera speed. Lighting is consistent with overhead market bulbs. Audio: Fast-paced action BGM, fabric rustling, quick footsteps on concrete.
[shot5][00:05-00:06] Open space within the market aisle, clear of obstacles to allow for a throwing motion. Ground is hard concrete. Lighting highlights the airborne subject. Audio: Heavy bass-boosted BGM, dull thud of body impact.
[shot6][00:06-00:07] Low angle view of the concrete ground, textured and slightly dirty. Shadows are long and sharp due to low camera position. Lighting is dramatic, casting deep shadows under the standing figure. Audio: Slower, menacing BGM with a high-pitched blade ring sound.
[shot7][00:07-00:09] High-angle俯视 (overhead) view looking down at the ground and the meat case edge. The wooden case texture is visible in the foreground. Background shows the market floor and scattered vegetables. Lighting is even, revealing details clearly. Audio: Menacing BGM continues, clear voice projection.
[shot8][00:09-00:10] Wide view of the market aisle extending into the distance. Background shows various market stalls and a crowd of onlookers (elderly, vendors). Lighting is bright and natural. Audio: Upbeat victory music, loud clapping and cheering.

# Subjects Description
<ID_A>: Female, young adult, East Asian. Long black hair flowing over shoulders. Wears a black long-sleeved top, a gray work apron, and black rubber rain boots. Features delicate facial features with sharp, focused eyes. Hands are capable and steady.
<ID_B>: Male, young adult, East Asian. Muscular build. Wears a white T-shirt, denim shorts, and slippers. Visible tattoos on arms. Short hair. Expression shifts from arrogant to fearful.
Vocal Characteristics: <ID_B> has a rough, aggressive male voice. <ID_A> has a clear, firm, and authoritative female voice.

# Dynamic Narrative
[shot1][00:00-00:02] Wide eye-level static shot. <ID_A> stands behind the wooden meat case center frame, slicing pork with a cleaver. <ID_B> enters from frame right, walking aggressively toward the case. <ID_B> violently kicks the stainless steel basin on the ground; the basin slides across the concrete with a screech. <ID_A> pauses cutting, head turning slightly toward the noise.
[shot2][00:02-00:03] Extreme close-up on <ID_A>'s face. Her eyes shift from focused to cold and sharp. She tilts her head slightly to the left, looking off-screen at the provocateur. Her expression hardens, jaw tightening visibly.
[shot3][00:03-00:04] Wide eye-level static shot. <ID_B> stands opposite the meat case, hands on hips, chest puffed out arrogantly. He faces <ID_A> directly. <ID_B> (aggressive tone) says: [00:03-00:04]「新来的卖肉的，懂不懂这条街的规矩？」. Bystanders in the background turn their heads to look.
[shot4][00:04-00:05] Medium tracking shot moving fast. <ID_A> swiftly steps out from behind the case, moving screen left to right. She closes the distance instantly, her hand shooting out to grab <ID_B>'s extended arm. Her body leans into the momentum, feet pivoting on the concrete.
[shot5][00:05-00:06] Medium quick push-in shot. <ID_A> uses leverage to lift <ID_B>. <ID_B>'s feet leave the ground, his body flipping horizontally in the air due to the shoulder throw. <ID_B> crashes onto the concrete back-first, limbs flailing upon impact.
[shot6][00:06-00:07] Low angle static shot. <ID_A>'s black rubber boot presses firmly onto <ID_B>'s chest. <ID_A> holds the silver cleaver horizontally against <ID_B>'s neck. <ID_B> lies flat on his back, eyes wide with fear, breathing heavily, hands raised in surrender.
[shot7][00:07-00:09] High-angle static shot. <ID_A> stands over <ID_B>, looking down calmly. Her left hand rests on her thigh, right hand holds the knife steady. <ID_A> (firm tone) says: [00:07-00:09]「这条街的规矩是明码标价，不是乱收费！」. <ID_B> remains pinned on the ground, nodding weakly.
[shot8][00:09-00:10] Wide eye-level static shot. <ID_B> scrambles up and crawls away toward the background, disappearing into the crowd. <ID_A> turns back to the meat case, wiping the knife. Surrounding crowd members clap and cheer, some raising thumbs.

# Style, Color & Aesthetics
Visual style is gritty realism with high-contrast lighting reminiscent of martial arts cinema. Color palette features warm tungsten market lights, raw red meat tones, gray concrete, and stark black/white clothing contrasts. Lighting utilizes directional overhead bulbs to create dramatic shadows (chiaroscuro) during the confrontation, shifting to brighter, even lighting for the resolution. Image quality is sharp with motion blur used intentionally during action sequences to enhance speed.

# Atmosphere & Emotion
The atmosphere transitions from chaotic daily life to tense confrontation, then explosive action, and finally satisfying justice. The emotion shifts from aggression to intimidation, culminating in empowerment and community approval. The pacing is urgent and rhythmic, designed to keep viewer engagement high throughout the 10 seconds.
